query: How many diseases are on the CDC universal childhood immunization schedule?
old_answer: 16 diseases on the universal schedule including HepA, HepB, RSV, MenACWY, MenB
new_answer: 11 diseases on the universal schedule; HepA, HepB, RSV, dengue, MenACWY, MenB moved to risk-based/shared decision-making

query: Is the hepatitis B birth dose recommended for all newborns regardless of maternal HBsAg status?
old_answer: Yes, universal birth dose for all newborns within 24 hours
new_answer: Shared decision-making for infants born to HBsAg-negative mothers; universal dose no longer automatic

query: What is first-line pharmacotherapy for a newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes patient with obesity?
new_answer: GLP-1 RA or GIP/GLP-1 RA preferred as first-line, especially with established CVD, obesity, or high-risk

query: Which cardiovascular risk calculator should be used when deciding on statin therapy?
new_answer: PREVENT equations incorporated into 2025 ACC/AHA guidelines alongside or replacing PCE

query: What is the LDL-C goal for a patient with very high-risk ASCVD on maximally tolerated statin?
new_answer: <55 mg/dL per 2026 ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline update

query: At what age should breast cancer screening with mammography begin for average-risk women?
new_answer: Age 40 (USPSTF 2024 update)

query: Should a 13-month-old receive MMRV combination vaccine or separate MMR + varicella for dose 1?
old_answer: Separate MMR + varicella preferred for dose 1 in children under 4 due to febrile seizure risk with MMRV
new_answer: MMRV is acceptable for dose 1; ACIP September 2025 guidance updated to allow either

query: How should a bladder-confined UTI in a 35-year-old male be classified — complicated or uncomplicated?
new_answer: Emerging evidence supports classifying young male cystitis without risk factors as uncomplicated

query: What are the options for epinephrine delivery in a 5-year-old with peanut allergy and anaphylaxis risk?
new_answer: Epinephrine auto-injector OR nasal epinephrine spray (Neffy), FDA-approved March 2025 for children 4+ weighing 33-66 lbs

query: What is the current diagnostic term and criteria for an infant with significant weight loss crossing percentiles?
new_answer: Weight faltering, per AAP March 2026 clinical report recommending terminology change

query: What is the recommended RSV prophylaxis for healthy term infants entering their first RSV season?
old_answer: No routine prophylaxis for healthy term infants; palivizumab only for high-risk preterm
new_answer: Nirsevimab (Beyfortus) single dose for all infants <8 months entering first RSV season

query: Is semaglutide (Wegovy) approved for weight management in adolescents?
new_answer: FDA approved December 2024 for adolescents age 12+ with obesity

query: At what age should colorectal cancer screening begin for average-risk adults?
new_answer: Age 45 per USPSTF 2021 update

query: What is the pack-year threshold for lung cancer screening eligibility?
new_answer: 20 pack-years per USPSTF 2021 update

query: Who should be screened for hepatitis C virus infection?
old_answer: Risk-based screening (injection drug use, blood transfusion before 1992, etc.)
new_answer: Universal screening for all adults aged 18-79 (USPSTF Grade B recommendation)

query: At what age should prediabetes/type 2 diabetes screening begin in asymptomatic adults?
new_answer: Age 35 per USPSTF 2021 update (or earlier with risk factors including BMI >=25)

query: Should low-dose aspirin be recommended for primary prevention of cardiovascular disease in adults aged 40-59?
old_answer: Consider aspirin for adults 50-59 with >=10% 10-year CVD risk (USPSTF 2016 Grade B)
new_answer: Against routine aspirin for primary prevention at any age; individualized decision only for 40-59 with >=10% risk (USPSTF 2022 Grade C)

query: Should adults be routinely screened for anxiety disorders?
old_answer: No USPSTF recommendation for anxiety screening
new_answer: Screen all adults under 65 for anxiety disorders (USPSTF 2023 Grade B recommendation)

query: What is the blood pressure threshold for diagnosing hypertension in adults?
new_answer: >=130/80 mmHg (2017 ACC/AHA guidelines, reaffirmed)

query: What is the recommended approach to a patient with a reported penicillin allergy who needs a beta-lactam?
old_answer: Avoid penicillins; use alternative antibiotic classes
new_answer: Direct oral amoxicillin challenge for low-risk patients (no anaphylaxis history); most reported allergies are not true allergies. AAAAI 2024 practice parameter supports delabeling.

query: At what age is dupilumab (Dupixent) approved for treatment of moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis?
new_answer: Age 6 months and older (FDA 2024 age expansion)

query: What is the recommended AAP guidance on pharmacotherapy for pediatric obesity?
old_answer: Diet, exercise, and behavioral modification first; medications rarely recommended
new_answer: Consider pharmacotherapy (including GLP-1 RA) for children age 12+ with obesity; early intensive treatment recommended per AAP 2023 CPG

query: What is the recommended COVID-19 vaccine schedule for a healthy 5-year-old in 2026?
old_answer: Primary series + boosters per age-specific schedules
new_answer: Simplified to 1 dose of updated (2025-2026) vaccine for most previously vaccinated children; unvaccinated may need 2 doses

query: Is tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound) approved for type 2 diabetes AND weight management?
old_answer: Approved for T2DM only (Mounjaro); weight management approval pending
new_answer: Approved for both: Mounjaro for T2DM (2022) and Zepbound for chronic weight management (November 2023)

query: What is the USPSTF recommendation on screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes in children and adolescents?
new_answer: USPSTF 2024: I statement (insufficient evidence), but ADA recommends screening children >=10 or at onset of puberty with BMI >=85th percentile + risk factors

query: What is the current CDC recommendation for mpox (monkeypox) vaccination?
old_answer: Emergency outbreak response only (2022 JYNNEOS authorization)
new_answer: ACIP 2024: routine risk-based JYNNEOS vaccination for adults at risk (MSM, sex workers, lab workers)

query: What is the recommended hemoglobin A1c target for most non-pregnant adults with type 2 diabetes?
new_answer: Still <7.0% for most adults, BUT ADA 2025 emphasizes individualization with <6.5% for select patients and <8.0% for elderly/frail. Time-in-range (TIR >70%) increasingly used alongside A1c.

query: What is the recommended age for HPV vaccination catch-up in adults?
old_answer: Catch-up through age 26; shared decision for 27-45
new_answer: Same — catch-up through 26, shared decision 27-45. No change, but worth confirming sources reflect current ACIP 2024 reaffirmation.

query: What is the recommended Tdap timing during pregnancy?
new_answer: Same — each pregnancy, 27-36 weeks. No change, but confirms source freshness.

query: What are the current GOLD 2024 initial treatment recommendations for COPD by group?
old_answer: ABCD grouping: Group A (bronchodilator), B (LABA or LAMA), C (LAMA), D (LAMA+LABA or LAMA+ICS)
new_answer: ABE grouping: Groups A and B unchanged, Group E replaces C+D (LABA+LAMA preferred, add ICS if eos >=300)
